summary: Prompt exploration can scale by separating clarification, planning and specification depth according to risk.

items.text: Use a risk-tiered plan mode: immediately execute reversible tasks, but require explicit approval of high-impact assumptions.
Add a task-intake proxy that detects missing actors, constraints, acceptance criteria and non-goals before an agent is assigned.
Promote the resolved exploration record into the versioned implementation specification instead of copying it into a separate document.
For complex changes, require the requester to confirm a concise intent restatement before detailed design begins.
